description: Top-level inline or linked database block. Renders an editable title and icon, a toolbar (filter, sort, group, sub-items, properties, import/export, and new-record with templates), view tabs, and the active view, loading fields, views, and records through the database provider.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Pins the database's own layout. Auto follows the cascaded layout (the editor decides it); a forced value lets a host — and a test — render a mode without a DOM.

parameters.name: ShowSearch
parameters.description: Shows the client-side "search records" field (NO2). Default off, so existing hosts are unchanged.

parameters.name: IsPage
parameters.description: The database fills the page (opened as a page, or the only content). Only then does the mobile action bar render; an inline block keeps the compact toolbar.
